title: WEST HAM'S PATIENCE LASTED 13 MONTHS. THEN CAME PARKER.
description:
Thirteen months. That's all Nuno got at West Ham.

Scott Parker, 46, was confirmed the very next morning. Not a search. A reflex.

Nuno had won only twice in six and lost at home to Southampton and West Brom. Then came Parker's first game, at Cardiff: 3-0 down by the 39th minute, 3-3 at the end. A fast start, at the wrong end.

Parker has won promotion from this league three times, with Fulham, Bournemouth and Burnley. He also played 129 times for West Ham before, and Mark Noble will work closely with him. A reunion, with homework.
